elements.label: EXAMPLE 4.1
elements.title: Confidence Interval Calculation for Mean Age of Arthritis Patients

nodes: Problem: Estimate population mean age for arthritis patients
Conclusion: 95% confidence interval is 60 to 68 years
connections: Sample mean = 64 years -> Margin of error = 4 years
Margin of error = 4 years -> Calculate confidence interval

elements.summary: This example shows the step-by-step calculation of a 95% confidence interval for the mean age of arthritis patients based on a sample mean and margin of error.
